expected.insightNarrative:
US_View is the Revenue by State dashboard for the United States: total revenue for the selected period on a hexagon map of the states, the same revenue ranked by state, and the invoice lines behind it at chart-of-account level. The selectors at the top are set to the period January 2021, state All and city All; clicking a state on the map filters the bar chart and the detailed view, and clicking a bar filters the detailed view. The story is revenue concentrated in California, which brings more than twice the revenue of any other state.

Key insights
- California leads with $1,125K of revenue, more than double the next state.
- New Jersey ($510K), Florida ($508K), Texas ($469K) and Illinois ($449K) form the next tier, followed by Pennsylvania ($430K), New York ($429K) and Massachusetts ($409K).
- The invoice lines behind the map total $8,898,330, with the largest single lines in New York, Salt Lake City, Chicago, San Francisco and Los Angeles.

HexBin Map
Total revenue by state as a hexagon map of the United States, one tile per state including Alaska, Hawaii, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico, shaded by revenue: California, Texas and Florida stand out as the darkest tiles.

Bar Chart
Total revenue by state, ranked: California leads with $1,125K, far ahead of New Jersey ($510K), Florida ($508K), Texas ($469K), Illinois ($449K), Pennsylvania ($430K), New York ($429K) and Massachusetts ($409K); Ohio ($315K), Michigan ($296K) and Virginia ($283K) follow, with the remaining states lower down the list.

US Detailed View
The detailed view at chart-of-account level: one row per invoice line with company code (888), account (20624, 20697, 20681, 20638, 20636, 20643 and others), business unit (5557, 5565, 5569, 5616, 5717), profit center (778), state and city, and the amount. The grand total is $8,898,330. The largest lines shown are in New York ($479 and $448), Salt Lake City, Utah ($436 and $421), Chicago, Illinois ($416), New York ($410), San Francisco, California ($408 and $388), Los Angeles ($400), Newport Beach ($389) and New York ($388).
